name: Shields Health Solutions
description: Shields Health Solutions builds and runs specialty pharmacy programs inside health systems, rather than operating a retail chain of its own. It partners with health systems across the country and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Walgreens Boots Alliance. Remote roles here are weighted toward clinical specialty pharmacists and certified technicians doing refill coordination, adherence outreach and prior-authorization support for health-system patients.

multi_state_licensure.note: Supports health system partners across many states.
